name: pmc-map-the-stakeholders
description: Builds a Stakeholder Map by role, showing who decides, who influences and who can block, with each role's interest, constraint, formal decision right and how to involve it before the decision date. Use for "run pmc-map-the-stakeholders", "map the stakeholders", "who decides on the pricing change", "who could block this", "power interest grid", "how should I involve finance", "my sign-off got reopened", part of the Claude Opus 5.5 for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
